exposure: body mass index at the beginning of pregnancy
Body mass index (BMI) at the beginning of pregnancy
cohort: 200 patients who delivered by cesarean section over a one-year period
finding: Higher BMI at the beginning of pregnancy was significantly associated with an increased likelihood of cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: The study found a significant association between body mass index at the beginning of pregnancy and cesarean section.
birth_weight: Neonatal birth weight was significantly associated with maternal BMI at the beginning of pregnancy.
